rationale: The workflow is a manual Docker build triggered by workflow_dispatch with a single job. The available evidence patterns either require preconditions not met (representative successful-duration history for timeout patterns P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), apply to scheduled/matrix/multi-job workflows (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST), or target dependency caching/test selection not relevant to this Docker build. The single historical run (11 minutes) is insufficient to establish a safe timeout baseline. Adding a timeout without representative history risks false failures on valid slow builds. No evidence-supported optimization fits this workflow's characteristics while preserving its intended behavior.
